title: Prime Minister greets Air Warriors on Air Force Day
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today greeted the Air Warriors on the occasion of Air Force Day.
The Prime Minister stated that India is proud of them, saluting their courage and commitment to protect the nation's skies.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"India is proud of our Air Warriors.
On Air Force Day, we salute their courage and commitment to protect our skies!"
India is proud of our Air Warriors. 

On Air Force Day, we salute their courage and commitment to protect our skies! https://t.co/ZiPJOlVd2C — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 8, 2026
